cases.question: What is the frequency of the seismic signal in anomaly ANM-0042?
cases.answer: The seismic signal in anomaly ANM-0042 has a frequency of 0.37 Hz. It was detected beneath Halvorsen Basin, initially with a period of 6.2 hours that shortened to 5.9 hours by Sol 48, and was recorded independently by seismometers S1, S2 and S4. (Note: the 1.2 Hz dominant frequency in RPT-CI-SEIS refers to the separate Kiln-2 Cinder site observations, not ANM-0042.)
contexts:
Science Report: Anomaly ANM-0042 > ## Observation
## Observation
A periodic seismic signal at 0.37 Hz was detected beneath Halvorsen Basin, first on Sol 42 with a period of 6.2 hours, shortening to 5.9 hours by Sol 48. The signal was recorded independently by seismometers S1, S2 and S4 (S3 was offline for maintenance), which rules out a single-instrument artifact.

# Planet Profile: Thalassa Prime

Thalassa Prime is the largest moon of the gas giant Aurelia. It hosts a global liquid-water ocean confirmed in 2231 by the probe Siren.

Planet Profile: Kepler-Vex > ## Structure
## Structure
The planet is covered by an ice shell estimated at 18–24 km thick. Gravity and magnetometer data from the ODY-02 Halcyon orbital survey strongly suggest a liquid subsurface ocean beneath the shell. The atmosphere is thin (0.08 bar), composed mostly of nitrogen with traces of methane.

Planet Profile: Thalassa Prime > ## Radiation
## Radiation
Because Thalassa Prime orbits inside Aurelia's magnetosphere, the surface radiation dose is 5.4 Sv/year, far above the HED crew limit. Crewed EVAs on the surface are limited to a maximum of 4 hours. Any crewed landing requires a radiation waiver approved by the Director of Exploration.

Planet Profile: Thalassa Prime > ## Structure
## Structure
The ice crust is 3–5 km thick at the poles but thins to approximately 0.9 km at the **Tethys Rift**, a 600 km long equatorial fracture zone. Surface gravity is 0.22 g. Surface temperature averages -170 °C.

# Planet Profile: Kepler-Vex

Kepler-Vex is the third planet orbiting the K-type star Vex. It is an ice world with a mean surface temperature of -142 °C and a surface gravity of 0.71 g. One local day (a "sol") lasts 31.4 hours.
